VERDICT: LGTM

The new `formatOwnerSegment` fits the existing structure cleanly:

- It follows the established `@Named("formatXxx") default String ...(Owner owner)` convention used by every other derived-field helper in this mapper, with the matching `@Mapping(... qualifiedByName = ...)` line wired into `toOwnerDto` in the same style and position as its neighbors.
- Logic lives in the right unit — segment derivation is a per-owner read-time formatting concern, exactly what this mapper already owns for `membershipLevel`, `locality`, `timezone`, etc.
- No duplication. It composes the two existing helpers (`formatMembershipLevel`, `formatLocality`) rather than re-deriving level or locality, and it reuses the existing `REGION_TIMEZONE` table's keys as the single source of truth for "known region" — the same table `formatTimezone` uses for the same NSW/VIC/QLD set. This keeps the "known region" concept from being duplicated as a separate hard-coded set, so segment/timezone/locality can't drift apart.
- Placement (between `formatLocality` and the `REGION_TIMEZONE`/`formatTimezone` block) keeps the locality-related helpers grouped, which reads naturally.
- The Javadoc matches the density and tone of the surrounding methods, and the null-guard idiom is consistent with the rest of the interface.
- The OpenAPI addition mirrors the existing read-only derived fields (title/description/enum/example/readOnly) in the right spot.

Nothing here is becoming a catch-all or needs restructuring.
